Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 1, 2026

Draft for review: This page describes the intended practices supplied for CŌR. Confirm the bracketed operational details and have the final policy reviewed before making it public.

Who this policy covers

This policy covers the CŌR iPhone and Apple Watch apps, the CŌR Active website, and the launch waitlist. “CŌR,” “we,” and “our” refer to CŌR Active. For privacy questions, contact support@coractive.co.

Information you provide

  • Account details supplied through Sign in with Apple or Google, such as an account identifier, name, or email address, handled through Supabase.
  • Profile and app information you choose to enter, including goals, meals, nutrition, workouts, weight, measurements, and feedback.
  • Health information you choose to connect through Apple Health, subject to the permissions you grant. Supported information may include steps, workouts, heart rate, sleep, weight, body fat, and meal calories or macros. You can manage access in Apple Health and iOS settings.
  • Photos, descriptions, and other content you submit when you choose an AI feature. A feature may send the content needed for that request to its AI service provider.
  • If you join the launch waitlist, your email address and subscription or confirmation status, handled through Brevo.

How information is used

We use information to operate and personalize CŌR, sync your account, show the health and fitness features you request, answer support messages, process an AI request you choose to make, and send waitlist or launch updates you signed up to receive.

Apple Health information

HealthKit access is permission-based. You can grant or deny supported read and write permissions separately. We use health information to provide CŌR health and fitness functionality. We do not sell health data and do not use it for advertising. Health data is not used to target ads. Information already written to Apple Health may remain there after you delete your CŌR account; manage or remove those records in Apple Health.

Optional AI features

AI features are optional. When you choose one, CŌR may send the text, image, or other information shown in that feature to an AI provider so it can return an estimate or response. Review the in-app notice before sending. [Before publication, list the active AI providers, the types of inputs each receives, and their retention or model-training terms.]

Service providers and sharing

We use service providers to operate the product: Supabase for authentication and app services, Apple and Google for sign-in, Apple HealthKit when you connect it, Brevo for waitlist email, and AI providers only when you choose an AI feature. We do not sell personal or health information and do not use health data for advertising. We may disclose information if required by law or to protect the service and its users.

How long we keep information

We keep account information while your account is active and for the time needed to provide the service, meet legal obligations, resolve disputes, and protect the service. Waitlist information is kept until you unsubscribe or ask us to remove it. [Confirm the actual retention period for backups, support messages, and provider logs before publication.]

Your choices and deletion

  • Change Apple Health permissions in Apple Health or iOS Settings.
  • Delete your CŌR account in the app’s Settings under “Delete Account.” Account deletion removes the account and associated CŌR data from active systems; [confirm backup deletion timing and any records that must be retained].
  • Use the unsubscribe link in a Brevo email to stop waitlist messages, or email support@coractive.co to request removal.
  • Contact us to ask about access, correction, or deletion of information.

Security and children

We use technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect information. No online service can guarantee absolute security. CŌR is not designed for children under 13, and we do not knowingly ask children under 13 to create an account.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as CŌR changes. We will update the date above and provide additional notice when required.

Questions? Contact support@coractive.co
